entrypoints.summary: A state-funded adversary able to conduct a TLS man-in-the-middle attack and control or obtain issuance from a trusted certificate authority supplies certificate material to Balrog's update-verification flow.

affected_components.role: Historical audited verification routine; its macOS conditional excluded certificate-chain verification.
Current post-remediation context: root-hash and content-signature checks return failure before update data is processed.

code_slices.fixed: Current validateSignature computes a root certificate hash, compares it with configured root hashes, then calls verify_content_signature and returns false on either failure.
code_slices.surrounding_context: Current code calls processData only after the preceding verification flow succeeds; it is not evidence of the exact historical patch.
code_slices.vulnerable: The audit reproduces the historical checkSignature fragment in which QSslCertificate::verify(list) is excluded under MVPN_MACOS.

impact.affected_asset: Integrity of Mozilla VPN updates on the affected macOS client
impact.attacker_capability: Replace the Mozilla VPN update binary through the reported TLS man-in-the-middle and trusted-CA threat model
impact.security_effect: Update substitution with malicious binary content

causal_trace.summary: Under the report's stated threat model, a TLS man-in-the-middle adversary with trusted-CA authority can interfere with the update connection and supply certificate material.
The macOS-specific conditional compilation excludes QSslCertificate::verify(list), so the update-signing certificate path is not whole-chain validated on macOS.
Because the certificate-chain verification operation is skipped, the report states that a self-signed leaf certificate can be supplied and Balrog's verification bypassed.
The report states that the adversary can replace Mozilla VPN update binary code with malicious malware.

primary_invariant.statement: Before accepting certificate-derived authority for an update signature, Balrog must validate the full certificate chain on every supported platform.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The reviewed checkSignature code omitted QSslCertificate::verify(list) when MVPN_MACOS was defined.

quality.review_notes: The primary audit explicitly documents the historical macOS conditional omission, impact, recommendation, and Cure53's August 2021 verified-fix note. No historical vulnerable commit, fix diff, regression test, or execution artifact is bundled. The current balrog.cpp is post-remediation context and cannot prove the exact historical repair.

remediation.invariant_restored: Certificate-derived update-signing authority must be rejected unless the trust path is validated on macOS as well as other platforms; the current reviewed source additionally rejects untrusted root hashes and failed content signatures before processing update data.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: macOS staging 2.0.5 (as reported by the audit)
